name: Discord
description: Discord is a communications platform organized around servers, channels, messages, communities, voice, video, and apps. Relay's Discord V1 is limited to safe bot identity, one administrator-selected guild, its non-NSFW text-channel metadata, and recent plain-text messages from one selected channel.
agentUseSummary: Install the Relay-owned bot into one selected guild so agents can review safe guild/channel metadata and up to twenty-five recent selected-channel text messages through four fixed GET-only wrappers. Self-bots, DMs, other guilds or channels, people and rich message data, search, writes, moderation, commands, Gateway, webhooks, pagination, and raw access are blocked.

credentialRequirements: Relay-owned Discord bot token retained only by Railway

blocked.description: Self-bots, user tokens, and acting as a Discord user are always blocked.

blocked.description: DMs, other guilds or channels, threads, voice, stage, forum, media, and NSFW content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access rich message data
blocked.description: Mentions, attachments, embeds, reactions, polls, components, snapshots, and other rich message data are excluded.

blocked.label: Search, change, or administer Discord
blocked.description: Search, writes, deletes, moderation, roles, permissions, invites, audit logs, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use event or command surfaces
blocked.description: Commands, interactions, Gateway connections, and webhooks are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broad or raw access
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, raw provider requests, RPC, GraphQL, and MCP surfaces are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four fixed selected-guild/channel GET reads run automatically; user automation, broader conversations, people and rich message data, search, writes, administration, events, pagination, and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four reads run without per-action approval; exact bot permissions, selected-guild/channel containment, safe projections, limits, audit, and API controls still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: A production Relay-owned Discord application/bot, Message Content privileged-intent approval, exact 66560 permissions install, selected guild/channel verification, and staging acceptance remain pending outside this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure and review the Relay-owned bot with only View Channels and Read Message History, obtain Message Content approval, then validate one staging guild and one non-NSFW text channel through Railway.

evidence.supports: Discord documents dedicated bot-token authentication, the bot OAuth2 install scope, guild permissions, and least-privilege guidance.
Discord documents permission bitfields and channel-specific permission overwrites.
Discord documents the GET channel messages endpoint, its 1-100 bound, and View Channel plus Read Message History requirements.
Discord documents Message Content as a privileged intent affecting message content across APIs and requiring approval for verified applications.
